usedFor: A “New Email Received” in AgentMail can open or update a deal in HubSpot.

bestTemplate.name: “New Email Received” in AgentMail, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: An inbound message signals new interest, and the deal gives someone ownership of the reply.

watchOut: “Update Deal” needs a deal ID and field values that an email event does not give you.
